subject: science
concept: Designing and conducting a safe investigation involving a chemical reaction, recording and interpreting observations
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Planning and Carrying Out Investigations) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student conducts a simple, safe reaction investigation and records signs of chemical change
exercise.pictorial: Student charts their observations using a before/after comparison
exercise.abstract: Student classifies their investigated reaction type and explains the evidence for the classification

assessment.mastery_threshold: classification is supported by actual recorded observations from the investigation
misconception_flags: classifies the reaction type without connecting the classification to their own recorded evidence

interest_binding: investigation topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
